summary: the metal cases on i686 with faults in the tree's metal_accept.sh, which machine.metal.unattended runs against the metal image

argv: ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run metal

faults.name: busy-fat
faults.summary: the acceptance holds a file of the stick open while it unmounts it, so the unmount fails though the writes were flushed

faults.name: short-mbr
faults.summary: the acceptance reads no bytes of the MBR, which dd reports as a success

lines: FAIL: disk: the published whole-disk window did not supply one complete sector
